title: kbask.py cleanup runs one capped Haiku session only when tidy has ask candidates, and posts one coord ask to the operator per candidate
goal: kbask.py cleanup [--root CLONE] reads tidy --json and starts no claude session when no candidate has the verdict ask; otherwise it starts one detached headless session of the kb-observer agent with --model haiku and --max-budget-usd 0.25, whose allowed tools read kbmon.py --json and tidy --json and write no file, and posts one coord ask addressed to the operator per ask candidate, naming its key; a second kbask.py cleanup while the first runs exits 1 through the coord claim remediate/cleanup

import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print("check failed:", e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import os, subprocess, sys, tempfile, json, time
T = tempfile.mkdtemp()
ENV = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(("GIT_", "KB_COORD"))}
ENV.pop("CLAUDECODE", None)
ENV.update(KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(T, "coord.sqlite"), GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=os.devnull, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM="1",
           GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="t", GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL="t@example.com", GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="t", GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="t@example.com")
def g(*a, cwd):
    return subprocess.run(["git", *a], cwd=cwd, env=ENV, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout
def tool(*a, env=None, ok=(0,)):
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, *a], capture_output=True, text=True, env=env or ENV, timeout=300)
    assert r.returncode in ok, (a, r.returncode, r.stdout[-800:], r.stderr[-800:])
    return r
O, C = os.path.join(T, "origin.git"), os.path.join(T, "clone")
g("init", "-q", "--bare", "-b", "main", O, cwd=T)
g("clone", "-q", O, C, cwd=T)
os.makedirs(os.path.join(C, "kb", "_self", "backlog"))
open(os.path.join(C, "backlog.json"), "w").write('{"item_dir": "kb/_self/backlog"}\n')
open(os.path.join(C, "kb", "_self", "backlog", ".keep"), "w").close()
g("add", "-A", cwd=C); g("commit", "-qm", "base", cwd=C); g("push", "-q", "origin", "main", cwd=C); g("fetch", "-q", cwd=C)
WT = os.path.join(C, ".claude", "worktrees")
def wt(name, branch=None, at="HEAD"):
    p = os.path.join(WT, name)
    g("worktree", "add", "-q", *(["-b", branch] if branch else ["--detach"]), p, at, cwd=C)
    return p
n = lambda p: os.path.normcase(os.path.realpath(p))
def own(p, cls, *a, env=None):
    return tool("_tools/backlog.py", "--root", C, "own", str(p), "--class", cls, *a, env=env)
def rows(*a):
    return json.loads(tool("_tools/backlog.py", "--root", C, "tidy", "--json", *a).stdout)
def by_path(rs, cls=None):
    return {n(x["path"]): x for x in rs if "path" in x and (cls is None or x.get("class") == cls)}
import stat
S = ENV["KB_COORD_STORE"]
BIN = os.path.join(T, "bin"); os.mkdir(BIN); MARK = os.path.join(T, "claude-started")
open(os.path.join(BIN, "claude"), "w").write("#!/bin/sh\necho \"$@\" >> " + MARK + "\necho '{\"result\": \"ok\", \"session_id\": \"x\"}'\n")
os.chmod(os.path.join(BIN, "claude"), 0o755)
E = dict(ENV, PATH=BIN + os.pathsep + ENV["PATH"])
ok = wt("agent-ok", "work/ST-aaaaaaaa"); own(ok, "worktree", "--item", "ST-aaaaaaaa")
tool("_tools/kbask.py", "cleanup", "--root", C, "--older-than", "0", env=E)
assert not os.path.exists(MARK), "a model call although tidy decided every candidate"
it = {"id": "ST-bbbbbbbb", "kind": "story", "title": "t", "status": "doing", "priority": "P2", "rank": 0, "goal": "g",
      "checks": [{"run": ["true"]}], "touches": ["x"]}
open(os.path.join(C, "kb", "_self", "backlog", "ST-bbbbbbbb.json"), "w").write(json.dumps(it, indent=2) + "\n")
g("add", "-A", cwd=C); g("commit", "-qm", "item", cwd=C); g("push", "-q", "origin", "main", cwd=C); g("fetch", "-q", cwd=C)
st = wt("agent-stale", "work/ST-bbbbbbbb"); own(st, "worktree", "--item", "ST-bbbbbbbb", "--session", "s-gone")
tool("_tools/kbask.py", "cleanup", "--root", C, "--older-than", "0", env=E)
argv = open(MARK).read()
assert argv.count("\n") == 1 and "haiku" in argv and "0.25" in argv, argv
ev = tool("_tools/coord.py", "--store", S, "wait", "--since", "0", "--timeout", "1").stdout
assert '"ask"' in ev and "operator" in ev, ev[-600:]
tool("_tools/coord.py", "--store", S, "claim", "remediate/cleanup", "--ttl", "600", "--holder", "other")
tool("_tools/kbask.py", "cleanup", "--root", C, "--older-than", "0", env=E, ok=(1,))
assert open(MARK).read().count("\n") == 1, "a second session started while the first holds the claim"
